blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace press officer Claire Castro will retain her role as the Marcos administration’s chief spokesperson despite a recent leadership shake-up at the Presidential Communications Office (PCO). PCO acting chief and Secretary Lino Cayetano confirmed on Friday that Castro would remain in her post, even as other officials appointed under the previous leadership […]...
